sentences.text: Of 11 material air-power developments this week, 5 of HIGH and 1 of MEDIUM relevance to Hungary.
Serbia receives first two Rafale fighters (moderate confidence, effect <12 months).
Hungary accepts first KC-390 transport (high confidence, effect <12 months).
Romania signs Letter of Offer and Acceptance for 32 F-35A (high confidence, effect >3 years).
Outside the region, the most significant changes were Germany orders 15 additional F-35A; China displays J-35A in PLAAF service markings — globally important, but of low direct relevance to Hungary.
In Hungary's immediate and near region, material change was assessed for Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Ukraine; no material change was identified for Russia, Austria, Slovakia, Czechia.
Collection gaps remain for Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Slovenia, Bulgaria; absence of reporting there is not evidence of inactivity.

page5.register_title: Source register — evidence behind each judgement
page5.source_note: Each S-xx links to the publication it names; titles are shown in their original language. Items cite only sources that directly report their subject: an official (Tier 1) source comes first where one exists, specialist media follow as corroboration. 'Context' sources are listed for audit but are not cited as evidence. 'Published' is the article's own publication date (from the feed or the article URL) — never an event, contract or milestone date; blank means not recorded. Lineage groups publications restating one evidence chain; state-controlled sources are attributed statements, not independent confirmation.

legend.title: Hungary relevance (HU)
items: Directly affects Hungary, its airspace, MH capability planning or NATO's Central/Eastern European air posture.
Affects the regional air picture or Allied posture around Hungary, but not Hungary directly.
A weak or indirect tie (distant actor, supplier link, doctrinal interest).
No direct link to Hungary, MH or NATO Central/Eastern Europe identified.

legend.title: Air-power significance (SIG)
items: A real but limited capability change.
A change with regional or global strategic weight.

legend.title: Analytic confidence (CONF)
items: First indication; thin or single-source reporting.
Credible reporting; not independently confirmed, or a single evidence lineage.
Multiple independent lineages or authoritative primary evidence.

legend.title: Effect horizon
items: Earliest operational effect within a year.
Earliest operational effect in one to three years.
Timing is not established in reporting.

legend.title: Collection status
items: At least 4 events from at least 2 sources in 60 days.
Some reporting, below the adequate threshold.
No reporting reached the collection in 60 days; absence of reporting is not evidence of inactivity.
Collection was at least PARTIAL and nothing material was assessed.

legend.title: Analytical terminology
items: Our judgement of what the fact means.
A stated plan or requirement; no commitment.
Aircraft or systems are being delivered to units.
Initial operational capability: a first unit can conduct the mission.
Full operational capability at planned scale.
Employed in its role (IOC or beyond).
The next concrete, checkable sign that would confirm or move the assessment.
A question collection could not answer that would change the assessment.

principles: significance ≠ confidence: how much it matters is not how sure we are.
procurement ≠ operational capability: a contract or delivery is not combat power.
delivery ≠ IOC: aircraft handed over are not a declared operational unit.
multiple articles ≠ independent evidence lineage: outlets restating one release are one lineage.
official statement ≠ independent confirmation: state-controlled sources count as one lineage and are always attributed.

developments.title: Serbia receives first two Rafale fighters
developments.fact: The Serbian Ministry of Defence stated that the first two Rafale aircraft landed at Batajnica. Two further aircraft are expected before year end, according to the ministry.
developments.capability_delta: Introduces a Western 4.5-generation fighter into the Serbian Air Force alongside its MiG-29 fleet; meaningful scale depends on crew and weapons delivery.
developments.so_what: Changes the combat air balance on Hungary's southern border over the next 1-3 years.
indicators_to_watch: Delivery of the next two aircraft before year end.
